definition: In this historical psychology source, feeling is the aspect of consciousness concerned with experienced changes apart from identifying objects or directing action. It is used broadly as a phase of mental life within the traditional division of knowledge, feeling, and will, and is treated as an abstraction from a fuller state of mind.
